spanish: Y tomó la grasa y la cola y toda la grasa que sobre el interior, y el lóbulo del hígado, y los dos los riñones y su grasa, y pierna de la derecha.

findings.issue: Verbless relative is left without a Spanish copula, so “que sobre el interior” is incomplete; no unmarked verb is added and the relation stays which-upon-the-interior.
Doubled article in “los dos los riñones”; the cardinal is still two and the noun is still the plural kidneys.
Definite construct שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין is bare “pierna de la derecha”; both nouns are present and the article on the right side is kept, but the head noun is not marked definite.

notes: Take, the three fat phrases, tail, all-the-fat upon the interior, liver lobe, two kidneys and their fat, and the right leg match the tokens.
